content: Official Obsidian Canvas docs show text/file cards, spatial arrangement and connections; JSON Canvas 1.0 specifies readable node IDs, content, geometry and edges. The official sample plugin offers a typed API, manifest and watch-build local authoring loop. Tapestry should use these as familiarity and SDK baselines, without assuming they provide deterministic branching or plugin-isolated replay. Sources: https://obsidian.md/help/plugins/canvas https://jsoncanvas.org/spec/1.0/ https://github.com/obsidianmd/obsidian-sample-plugin
